validated_product.standardized_title: Parker Series BVAL 2-Way Aluminum Ball Valve

attributes.source_citation: Stem Material Brass, Oversize Bearing Area
Standard Shaft Seals O-Ring & Backup, Nitrile
This series is available from 1/4" to 4" ports NPT, SAE and BSPP

validated_product.marketing_description: Parker Series BVAL 2-way ball valves are engineered to deliver reliable, leak-free performance in suction line and low-pressure hydraulic applications. Featuring a lightweight aluminum body and a chrome-plated brass ball, these valves utilize top-grade PTFE ball seats and robust O-ring seals to ensure smooth, unrestricted flow while eliminating cavitation. Designed for simple 90-degree on/off operation, the BVAL series is available in port sizes ranging from 1/4" to 4" with NPT, SAE, BSPP, and ISO 6149 thread options to suit diverse industrial systems.
bullet_points: Unrestricted bore from 1/4" to 4" eliminates cavitation and ensures maximum flow efficiency
Lightweight and durable aluminum body construction with chrome-plated brass ball
Top-grade PTFE ball seats with O-ring seals ensure smooth, leak-free operation
Available with NPT, BSPP, SAE, and ISO 6149 thread options for versatile system integration
Rated for working pressures up to 28 Bar (400 PSI) and temperatures from -30°C to +100°C
Optional seal materials available for compatibility with phosphate esters, water glycols, and other media
